notes.title: Paupers 1.1 with Spectral Currency Exchange Office are out!
notes.content:
[b]Finally! The Spectral Currency Exchange Office is here![/b] Now you can obtain holy coins from ascending ghosts and spend them on shiny new glamorous perks. Get your SWAG now!

Collect them all to unlock the ultimate reward: [b]THE CRYPT[/b] - your own cozy place in the cemetery! [Coming in Patch 1.2]

All of this, of course, comes with an achievements refresh! And the [b]promised Pope character is here [/b]- check out his fashionable outfit!

[h3]Full changelog:[/h3]

[b]Features[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added spectral coins
[*] Added Spectral Currecny Exchange Office
[*] Added temporary invulnerability after taking damage
[*] Added skipping cinematics with LMB
[*] Added 10 unlockable perks
[*] Added two new playable characters
[*] Added 4 new achievements
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with ghost not being able to reach the circle beacuse of player blocking the way
[*] Fixed multiple misc issues with identification
[/list]
